versions.changelog:
guaikei-xhs-creator-notes-collector 1.0.0

- Initial release providing retrieval of real interaction data (likes, comments, saves) for Xiaohongshu (RED) creators’ public posts and individual notes.
- Supports keyword search, note details viewing, comment collection, and creator post monitoring.
- Command-line interface with flexible options for filtering and data volume.
- Useful for KOL screening and partnership decision-making by assessing authentic engagement quality.
- Includes clear documentation, usage decision tree, error handling, and parameter reference.
